mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_id, user_name, password, account, status, balance, integral, credit, level, avatar, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{account}, #{status}, #{balance}, #{integral}, #{credit}, #{level}, #{avatar}, #{deleted})
INSERT INTO trade_transaction (goods_id, session_id, trade_state) VALUES (#{goodsId},#{sessionId},0)
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_transaction SET trade_state=#{select} WHERE goods_id=#{goodsId} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
UPDATE goods SET sold=#{toUid} WHERE user_id=#{currentUid} AND goods_id=#{goodsId}
UPDATE goods SET finished=1 WHERE goods_id=#{goodsId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favourite WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND item_id=#{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from user where account = #{account} and password = #{password} and deleted = 0
SELECT user_name FROM user WHERE account = #{string} AND deleted = 0
SELECT user_name,account FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT g.goods_id, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, img_height FROM goods g LEFT JOIN (SELECT goods_id, img_url, img_width, img_height, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY goods_id ORDER BY id ASC) AS rn FROM goods_image) gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id AND gi.rn = 1 WHERE g.goods_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM favourite WHERE favourite.user_id = #{currentUserId})
select user_id, user_name, account, status, level, integral, credit, balance, deleted, avatar from user where user_id= #{currentUserId}
select user_name from user where user_id= #{currentUserId}
SELECT session_id FROM session_state WHERE (from_uid=#{fromUid} AND to_uid=#{toUid}) OR (from_uid=#{toUid} AND to_uid=#{fromUid})

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar, t.content, t.msg_type, t.send_time, t.session_id
FROM ( SELECT cm.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY cm.session_id ORDER BY cm.send_time DESC ) AS rn
FROM chat_message cm
WHERE cm.from_uid =#{currentUserId} OR cm.to_uid = #{currentUserId}
) t
JOIN user u
ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN t.from_uid =#{currentUserId} THEN t.to_uid ELSE t.from_uid END
WHERE t.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.send_time DESC
SELECT session_id FROM session_state WHERE (from_uid=#{currentUserId} or to_uid=#{currentUserId}) AND group_id=0
SELECT session_id, from_uid, to_uid, content, msg_type, send_time FROM chat_message WHERE session_id =#{sessionId} and group_id = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN from_uid = #{userId} THEN to_uid WHEN to_uid = #{userId} THEN from_uid END AS other_uid FROM session_state WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND (from_uid = #{userId} OR to_uid = #{userId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT g.goods_desc, g.goods_id, g.price, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.id = ( SELECT gi2.id FROM goods_image gi2 WHERE gi2.goods_id = g.goods_id ORDER BY gi2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.goods_id = ( SELECT stg.goods_id FROM session_to_goods stg WHERE stg.session_id = #{sessionId} AND stg.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY stg.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT g.goods_desc, g.goods_id, g.price, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.id = (SELECT gi2.id FROM goods_image gi2 WHERE gi2.goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1) WHERE g.goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT g.goods_id, g.goods_desc, g.price, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, tt.trade_state FROM goods g LEFT JOIN trade_transaction tt ON g.goods_id = tt.goods_id AND tt.session_id = #{sessionId}
LEFT JOIN (SELECT goods_id, img_url, img_width, img_height FROM goods_image WHERE id IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM goods_image GROUP BY goods_id)) gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id WHERE g.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND g.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods WHERE user_id=#{currentUserId} AND goods_id=#{goodsId}

SELECT g.goods_id, g.goods_desc, g.price, gi.img_url as picture FROM goods g LEFT JOIN (SELECT goods_id, img_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY goods_id ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM goods_image) gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id AND gi.rn = 1 WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.finished IS NULL AND (g.sold IS NOT NULL AND g.sold != 0)
SELECT CASE WHEN user_id = #{myId} THEN sold WHEN sold = #{myId} THEN user_id ELSE NULL END FROM goods WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1

SELECT g.goods_id, g.goods_desc, g.price, gi.img_url AS picture FROM goods g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, img_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY goods_id ORDER BY id ASC) AS rn FROM goods_image ) gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id AND gi.rn = 1 WHERE g.sold = #{userId} AND g.finished IS NULL
